extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic-performance figures digitised from plotted markers/bars. Figure 3b–d Arrhenius plots, Figure 5–6 chemisorption/DRIFTS characterisation, Figure 8d literature-comparison plot, and Figure 9 DFT calculations were skipped according to the instructions. Figure 7b,d product-yield/contact-time panels were not encoded because the output schema has no product-yield field and the same GHSV-dependent selectivity/conversion/STY data are captured from Figure 4c,f; Figure 7a,c selectivity-vs-conversion trends were also not separately encoded to avoid duplicating the GHSV series without the underlying GHSV mapping. Values are approximate readings from the plotted bars/markers; all plotted values use qualifier '~'.
